item.title: Solved: How to Sort MongoDB with PyMongo
item.description:
In your quest to utilize the sort functionality while querying MongoDB databases via PyMongo, it's common to face challenges that may not occur when utilizing the MongoDB shell. If you're encountering issues, worry not! Below, I outline several strategies to effectively sort your results in MongoDB with PyMongo, ensuring robust performance and correct syntax.

### What’s Not Working?

Consider the original query:

```python
import pymongo

from pymongo import MongoClient
client = MongoClient()
db = client.myDB
print(db.posts.count_documents({}))
for post in db.posts.find({}, {'entities.user_mentions.screen_name': 1}).sort({u'entities.user_mentions.screen_name': 1}):
    print(post)
